summary: Milestone 2026.05.239 produced 0 experiment commits before retro generation — the milestone was in the planning/activation phase at retro time. Both RTX 3090 GPUs sat idle at 0% utilization with no compute-bound tasks scheduled. No timing data exists to analyse; all interpretive fields reflect that absence.
bottlenecks_identified: Retro triggered before any experiment activated: no commits land in the timing window, making every numeric field 0 and rendering GPU-utilisation analysis vacuous.

Persistent gap between roadmap planning and first-experiment activation: the conductor archives the prior milestone and writes the new roadmap in the same outer-loop turn, but experiment exp2471 (archive + activate) has not yet committed, so the timing anchor is never set.
improvements_suggested: Gate operational retro trigger on a minimum experiment count (>=1 commit in the timing window); if the gate is not met, emit a lightweight 'planning-only' stub and defer the full retro until at least one experiment completes.
Pre-activate exp2471 (archive + activate) in the same session as roadmap planning so the timing anchor is set before the retro fires.
Deploy a persistent conductor daemon that picks up the roadmap and begins activation without waiting for the next outer-loop turn.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Gate retro on minimum experiment count: avoids generating a structurally empty retro (17th consecutive occurrence) and saves outer-loop turn budget.
Same-session activation of exp2471: collapse roadmap-write and first-task-activation into one outer-loop turn so the timing window always contains at least one commit.
Persistent conductor daemon: eliminates the inter-session gap between roadmap commit and first experiment launch, the root cause of all empty-timing-window milestones.
meta_reflection: This is the seventeenth consecutive milestone where the retro fires on an empty timing window. The structural root cause — retro triggered before exp2471 activates — has been identified in every prior retro but not yet resolved mechanically. The highest-value action remains unchanged: make the retro gate on experiment count, not on milestone boundary.
